2608.13482.title: Synthetic Persona Pretraining: Alignment from Token Zero
2608.13482.paper_summary: As language-model-based AI is increasingly deployed in autonomous settings, aligning its goals and values with those of humans becomes critical. Today, alignment, and the assistant identity itself, are typically introduced only after pretraining, once behavioral priors are already established. This can make values a thin overlay, rather than deeply rooted, and facilitate subsequent misalignment. Pursuing a different paradigm, we introduce Synthetic Persona Pretraining (SPP), which installs the desired assistant persona from token zero in pretraining. First, we annotate pretraining documents with value-aligned first-person reflections derived from a normative value constitution. Second, we pretrain via the standard cross-entropy loss on standard pretraining documents as well as their reflections, which installs the desired persona among a multitude of other personas. Finally, we post-train on user-assistant dialogue data, which binds this desired persona to the assistant identity, a process we call persona binding. By pretraining models up to 3B parameters on 500B tokens, we show that SPP improves constitution following and jailbreak robustness, and reduces the misalignment rate in out-of-distribution moral dilemmas, while preserving capabilities. Early intervention matters: compared with alignment from token zero, introducing SPP only at the end of pretraining yields weaker constitution adherence, does not shift value priorities, and leads to less aligned choices in dilemmas. This advantage depends on persona binding and, importantly, increases with pretraining budget. Overall, our results show that shaping values early is critical for alignment and establish pretraining-time persona interventions as an effective approach to do so.
2608.13482.paper_summary_zh: 隨著基於語言模型的人工智慧在自主環境中越來越多地被部署，將其目標和價值觀與人類的目標和價值觀對齊變得至關重要。如今，對齊以及助理身份本身通常僅在預訓練之後引入，當行為先驗已經建立時。這可能使得價值觀變得淺薄，而不是深深根植，並促進隨後的錯位。追求不同的範式，我們引入了合成角色預訓練（SPP），它從預訓練的第一個標記開始就安裝所需的助理角色。首先，我們用來自規範價值憲法的價值對齊第一人稱反思來註釋預訓練文檔。其次，我們通過標準的交叉熵損失在標準預訓練文檔及其反思上進行預訓練，這在眾多其他角色中安裝了所需的角色。最後，我們在用戶-助理對話數據上進行後訓練，這將所需的角色與助理身份綁定，我們稱之為角色綁定。通過在500B標記上預訓練最多3B參數的模型，我們顯示SPP改善了憲法遵循和越獄穩健性，並降低了在分佈外道德困境中的錯位率，同時保留了能力。早期干預很重要：與從零標記開始的對齊相比，僅在預訓練結束時引入SPP會導致較弱的憲法遵循，不會改變價值優先級，並在困境中導致較少的對齊選擇。這一優勢依賴於角色綁定，並且重要的是，隨著預訓練預算的增加而增加。總體而言，我們的結果顯示，早期塑造價值觀對於對齊至關重要，並確立了預訓練時期的角色干預作為有效的方法。
